propositions: S3 recovery operation must be invoked exactly once at the validated write boundary in reconcile.py, after staleness validation and before the first remote fetch.
Recovery invocation must not occur in read-only, dry-run, preview, selection, or filtered reconcile paths; only write-bearing unscoped passes execute the operation.
Completion failure must preserve the overlap for retry and must not trigger any remote provider calls since the invocation precedes fetch operations.
A durable tombstone cannot be revoked by automatic confirmation, absence clearing, or same-key reconfirmation; only explicit unretire removes it.
The repair_at_write_boundary method guards invocation by persist and scoped parameters, returning empty outcome without writes when conditions are not met.
